benchmark_type_evidence: The Turkish dataset is TurkishMMLU, which was a separate project (Yüksel et al., 2024). The remaining 8 language subsets are newly created in this paper.
brief_description: A comprehensive, natively developed multilingual language understanding benchmark for Turkic languages, consisting of 38,139 middle- and high-school level multiple-choice questions across 11 academic subjects in 9 Turkic languages (Azerbaijani, Crimean Tatar, Karakalpak, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Tatar, Turkish, Uyghur, and Uzbek). TUMLU-mini is a balanced and manually verified subset with ~100 questions per subject per language.
